`legacy-webview-schema4.json` is built with the shipped `prepareSaveJson()` in
`app/src/main/assets/content-runtime/save.js`. It includes the four current
preset types, two compressed save generations for the island, a stale
localStorage copy, and the complete IndexedDB vault rows and metadata.

`legacy-island-direct.json` records the older direct `feral.world.v1` shape
handled by the existing island converter. It is retained as raw decoded source
for native conversion; the migration tests verify its terrain and inventory
fields remain available.

`legacy-webview-runtime.json` is generated by `tools/native/export-save-fixtures.mjs` through the shipped `ExpeditionRuntime` and `ExpeditionSave` APIs. It contains compressed schema-4 vault saves for all four current launcher presets, plus complete localStorage and IndexedDB export shapes. Each save has seeded inventory, finished and partial research, a partial craft job, atlas edits and a detached object pose, a wounded creature, and assembled machine state; applicable presets also contain First Signal or machine-field progress. The native migration integration test imports this fixture, loads the decoded unified payload through all three native subsystem loaders, and verifies the resulting public state.
